SELECT
    t1.audregistry AS audio_id,
    t2.makername AS manufacturer_name,
    t2.modnum AS model_number,
    t1.thdpct AS total_harmonic_distortion,
    t1.spksensedb AS speaker_sensitivity,
    t1.audlatms AS audio_latency,
    (t1.thdpct + t1.spksensedb + t1.audlatms) AS calculated_AQI
FROM
    audioandmedia AS t1
JOIN
    deviceidentity AS t2 ON t1.auddevref = t2.devregistry
WHERE
    t1.thdpct > 8.0
ORDER BY
    calculated_AQI DESC;

SELECT 
    am.audregistry AS "Audio ID", 
    di.makername AS "Manufacturer Name", 
    di.modnum AS "Model Number", 
    am.thdpct AS "Total Harmonic Distortion", 
    am.spksensedb AS "Speaker Sensitivity", 
    am.audlatms AS "Audio Latency", 
    (am.spksensedb * 0.4) + (100 - (am.thdpct * 10)) * 0.6 AS "Calculated AQI Value"
FROM 
    audioandmedia am 
JOIN 
    deviceidentity di ON am.auddevref = di.devregistry 
JOIN 
    performance p ON am.audperfref = p.perfregistry 
WHERE 
    (am.spksensedb * 0.4) + (100 - (am.thdpct * 10)) * 0.6 > 8.0 
ORDER BY 
    "Calculated AQI Value" DESC;

2b5fe0a28ff9584079477908a36178fddb7fd3ac.sql:
SELECT 
    d.makername AS manufacturer,
    d.modnum AS model,
    ts.devscope AS device_type,
    r.rgbbright AS rgb_brightness,
    r.rgbcoloracc AS color_accuracy,
    r.rgbzones AS number_of_rgb_zones,
    r.rgbmodes AS rgb_modes,
    r.rgbcolors AS supported_colors,
    -- Calculate RGB Implementation Quality Score
    (
        r.rgbbright * 0.2 + 
        r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + 
        r.rgbzones * 0.15 + 
        CAST(NULLIF(r.rgbmodes, '') AS NUMERIC) * 0.15 + 
        r.rgbcolors * 0.2
    ) AS rgb_implementation_quality_score,
    -- Classify RGB Quality based on the calculated score
    CASE
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + CAST(NULLIF(r.rgbmodes, '') AS NUMERIC) * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) > 8.0 THEN 'Premium RGB Implementation'
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + CAST(NULLIF(r.rgbmodes, '') AS NUMERIC) * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.0 THEN 'High-Quality RGB'
        WHEN (r.rgbbright * 0.2 + r.rgbcoloracc * 0.3 + r.rgbzones * 0.15 + CAST(NULLIF(r.rgbmodes, '') AS NUMERIC) * 0.15 + r.rgbcolors * 0.2) BETWEEN 3.0 AND 5.9 THEN 'Standard RGB'
        ELSE 'Basic RGB'
    END AS rgb_classification
FROM 
    deviceidentity d
JOIN 
    testsessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
JOIN 
    rgb r ON d.devregistry = r.rgbregistry
ORDER BY 
    rgb_implementation_quality_score DESC;

be094405e32e58c0ab4a4928c6af3bfeab9af7d7.sql:
SELECT 
    t1.audregistry AS audio_id,
    t2.makername AS manufacturer_name,
    t2.modnum AS model_number,
    t1.thdpct AS total_harmonic_distortion,
    t1.spksensedb AS speaker_sensitivity,
    t1.audlatms AS audio_latency,
    (
        (1 - (t1.thdpct / 2)) * 
        (t1.spksensedb / 100) * 
        (1 - (t1.audlatms / 100)) * 
        10
    ) AS aqi_value
FROM 
    audioandmedia AS t1
JOIN 
    deviceidentity AS t2 ON t1.auddevref = t2.devregistry
WHERE 
    (
        (1 - (t1.thdpct / 2)) * 
        (t1.spksensedb / 100) * 
        (1 - (t1.audlatms / 100)) * 
        10
    ) > 8.0
ORDER BY 
    aqi_value DESC;

f5eca38fca5229bd5d36be784965e8d3e277e788.sql:
SELECT 
    t1.audregistry AS audio_id,
    t2.makername AS manufacturer_name,
    t2.modnum AS model_number,
    t1.thdpct AS total_harmonic_distortion,
    t1.spksensedb AS speaker_sensitivity,
    t1.audlatms AS audio_latency,
    -- Calculate AQI as per the given formula
    (
        (10 * t1.spksensedb) + 
        (5 * (100 - (t1.thdpct * 100))) + 
        (3 * (100 - (t1.audlatms * 10)))
    ) AS calculated_AQI
FROM 
    audioandmedia AS t1
JOIN 
    deviceidentity AS t2 ON t1.auddevref = t2.devregistry
WHERE 
    -- Assuming Audio Quality is represented by the calculated AQI
    (
        (10 * t1.spksensedb) + 
        (5 * (100 - (t1.thdpct * 100))) + 
        (3 * (100 - (t1.audlatms * 10)))
    ) > 8.0
ORDER BY 
    calculated_AQI DESC;

WITH BatteryEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.makername,
        t1.modnum,
        t2.battlifeh,
        t2.battcapmah,
        t2.chgtimemin,
        t1.pwractmw AS powerdraw,
        (t2.battlifeh / t2.battcapmah) * 100 AS battery_efficiency_ratio,
        CASE 
            WHEN (t2.battlifeh / t2.battcapmah) * 100 > 90 THEN 'High'
            WHEN (t2.battlifeh / t2.battcapmah) * 100 BETWEEN 70 AND 90 THEN 'Medium'
            ELSE 'Low'
        END AS classification
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        testsessions AS t2 ON t1.devsessionref = t2.sessionregistry
)
SELECT 
    makername,
    modnum,
    battlifeh,
    battcapmah,
    chgtimemin,
    powerdraw,
    battery_efficiency_ratio,
    classification,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY makername ORDER BY battery_efficiency_ratio DESC) AS percentile_ranking
FROM 
    BatteryEfficiency
ORDER BY 
    makername, battery_efficiency_ratio DESC;

WITH BatteryEfficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.makername AS maker_name,
        t1.modnum AS model,
        t2.battlifeh AS battery_life,
        t2.battcapmah AS battery_capacity,
        t1.pwractmw AS power_draw,
        (t2.battlifeh * t2.battcapmah) / (t1.pwractmw * 10.0) AS battery_efficiency_ratio,
        CASE
            WHEN (t2.battlifeh * t2.battcapmah) / (t1.pwractmw * 10.0) > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'
            WHEN (t2.battlifeh * t2.battcapmah) / (t1.pwractmw * 10.0) BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.5 THEN 'Good Efficiency'
            WHEN (t2.battlifeh * t2.battcapmah) / (t1.pwractmw * 10.0) BETWEEN 2.5 AND 4.9 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
            ELSE 'Poor Efficiency'
        END AS efficiency_classification,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.makername ORDER BY (t2.battlifeh * t2.battcapmah) / (t1.pwractmw * 10.0)) AS percentile_ranking
    FROM 
        deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN 
        testsessions AS t2 ON t1.devsessionref = t2.sessionregistry
    WHERE 
        t1.conntype ILIKE '%wireless%'
)
SELECT 
    maker_name,
    model,
    battery_life,
    battery_capacity,
    power_draw,
    battery_efficiency_ratio,
    efficiency_classification,
    percentile_ranking
FROM 
    BatteryEfficiency
ORDER BY 
    maker_name, 
    percentile_ranking DESC;

WITH UltraResponsiveDevices AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.sessionregistry AS device_id,
        t2.makername AS manufacturer,
        t2.modnum AS model_number,
        t1.pollratehz AS polling_rate,
        t1.inplagms AS input_lag,
        t1.resptimems AS response_time,
        (t1.pollratehz * 1000) / (t1.inplagms + t1.resptimems) AS calculated_irs
    FROM 
        testsessions AS t1
    JOIN 
        deviceidentity AS t2 ON t1.sessionregistry = t2.devsessionref
    WHERE 
        t1.devscope IN ('Keyboard', 'Mouse')
        AND t1.inplagms < 1.0
        AND t1.resptimems < 0.5
        AND (t1.pollratehz * 1000) / (t1.inplagms + t1.resptimems) > 9.0
)
SELECT 
    device_id,
    manufacturer,
    model_number,
    polling_rate,
    input_lag,
    response_time,
    calculated_irs
FROM 
    UltraResponsiveDevices
ORDER BY 
    calculated_irs DESC;

WITH rgb_quality AS (
  SELECT 
    d.makername AS manufacturer, 
    d.modnum AS model, 
    ts.devscope AS device_type, 
    r.rgbbright AS rgb_brightness, 
    r.rgbcoloracc AS color_accuracy, 
    r.rgbzones AS num_rgb_zones, 
    r.rgbmodes AS rgb_modes, 
    r.rgbcolors AS supported_colors, 
    -- Assuming the RGB implementation quality score is calculated based on the average of brightness, color accuracy, and number of RGB zones
    (r.rgbbright + r.rgbcoloracc + r.rgbzones) / 3 AS rgb_quality_score,
    -- Assuming the RGB classification is based on the RGB quality score
    CASE 
      WHEN (r.rgbbright + r.rgbcoloracc + r.rgbzones) / 3 > 90 THEN 'High'
      WHEN (r.rgbbright + r.rgbcoloracc + r.rgbzones) / 3 > 70 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END AS rgb_classification
  FROM 
    DeviceIdentity d
    JOIN TestSessions ts ON d.devsessionref = ts.sessionregistry
    JOIN Mechanical m ON d.devregistry = m.mechdevref
    JOIN RGB r ON m.mechregistry = r.rgbmechref
)
SELECT 
  manufacturer, 
  model, 
  device_type, 
  rgb_brightness, 
  color_accuracy, 
  num_rgb_zones, 
  rgb_modes, 
  supported_colors, 
  rgb_quality_score, 
  rgb_classification
FROM 
  rgb_quality
ORDER BY 
  rgb_quality_score DESC;

WITH wireless_devices AS (
    SELECT
        t.battlifeh AS battery_life,
        t.battcapmah AS battery_capacity,
        d.pwridlemw AS power_draw_idle,
        d.pwractmw AS power_draw_active,
        d.makername AS maker_name,
        d.modnum AS model,
        d.conntype AS connection_type
    FROM 
        testsessions AS t
    JOIN 
        deviceidentity AS d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
    WHERE 
        d.conntype ILIKE '%wireless%'
),
battery_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        *,
        battery_life / battery_capacity AS battery_efficiency_ratio,
        CASE 
            WHEN battery_life / battery_capacity > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'
            WHEN battery_life / battery_capacity BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.5 THEN 'Good Efficiency'
            WHEN battery_life / battery_capacity BETWEEN 2.5 AND 4.9 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
            ELSE 'Poor Efficiency'
        END AS battery_efficiency_classification,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY maker_name ORDER BY battery_life / battery_capacity) AS percentile_ranking
    FROM 
        wireless_devices
)
SELECT 
    maker_name,
    model,
    battery_life,
    battery_capacity,
    (power_draw_active + power_draw_idle) / 2 AS power_draw,
    battery_efficiency_ratio,
    battery_efficiency_classification,
    percentile_ranking
FROM 
    battery_efficiency
ORDER BY 
    maker_name, 
    percentile_ranking DESC;

bcbfa685f6b7c074181e11d17ee4a62d9feab427.sql:
WITH wireless_devices AS (
    SELECT 
        t.sessionregistry,
        d.makername,
        d.modnum,
        t.battlifeh AS battery_life,
        t.battcapmah AS battery_capacity,
        d.pwridlemw AS idle_power_consumption,
        d.pwractmw AS active_power_consumption,
        d.conntype
    FROM 
        testsessions t
    JOIN 
        deviceidentity d ON t.sessionregistry = d.devsessionref
    WHERE 
        d.conntype ILIKE '%wireless%' -- Filter for wireless devices
),
battery_efficiency AS (
    SELECT 
        wd.*,
        (
            (battery_capacity / 3.6) / -- Convert mAh to Wh
            NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0) -- Average power consumption in mW
        ) * 10 AS battery_efficiency_ratio,
        CASE 
            WHEN ((battery_capacity / 3.6) / NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0)) * 10 > 7.5 THEN 'Excellent Efficiency'
            WHEN ((battery_capacity / 3.6) / NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0)) * 10 BETWEEN 5.0 AND 7.5 THEN 'Good Efficiency'
            WHEN ((battery_capacity / 3.6) / NULLIF((idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2, 0)) * 10 BETWEEN 2.5 AND 4.9 THEN 'Average Efficiency'
            ELSE 'Poor Efficiency'
        END AS battery_efficiency_classification
    FROM 
        wireless_devices wd
),
percentile_ranking AS (
    SELECT 
        be.*,
        PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY makername ORDER BY battery_efficiency_ratio DESC) AS percentile_ranking
    FROM 
        battery_efficiency be
)
SELECT 
    makername,
    modnum,
    battery_life,
    battery_capacity,
    (idle_power_consumption + active_power_consumption) / 2 AS power_draw,
    battery_efficiency_ratio,
    battery_efficiency_classification,
    percentile_ranking
FROM 
    percentile_ranking;
